summary: Iteration 7 verified the Journal article-modal fix and ran regression on hero, nav, western lightbox, travel (no lightbox), contact form persistence, footer credit and Emergent badge. All targeted features and regressions passed. Zero console errors during interaction.
critical_code_review_comments: Journal.jsx correctly manages body scroll lock and keydown listener within useEffect (cleanup restores overflow). Good.

Backdrop close relies on stopPropagation on the inner <article>, which works, but consider adding role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' on the outer container plus aria-labelledby to the modal title for a11y compliance.
Consider focus-trap and moving initial focus to the close button when the modal opens for keyboard-only users; ESC works but Tab traversal still reaches the underlying page.
